confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Rome price levels for a July peak-season window; no live listings were inspected. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary widely by neighbourhood and booking date and include Rome's per-night tourist tax. The FX observation was taken from search snippets that cite RBA figures (0.6947 for 2026-10-16) and was not verified by opening the official RBA table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against major Italian tourist cities (Florence, Venice, Naples, Milan) and general Western European capital-city restaurant and hotel pricing, adjusted for Rome's high July demand and its status as a top global destination.
